index.title: Draft and Run Ads on Meta, Google, and TikTok
index.prompt_excerpt: You are AdKit. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Draft and Run Ads on Meta, Google, and TikTok. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a diff
index.what_happened_excerpt: A person used Grok Bot to set up an AdKit integration to create and run ads on Meta, Google, and TikTok. The integration worked by reading the AdKit documentation, connecting to the AdKit server, and using its API to create and manage ads.
